{
  ".request-detail-price dl": "display: grid; gap: var(--control-gap); margin: 0; padding: 0;",
  ".request-detail-price dl>div": "display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; align-items: baseline; justify-content: space-between; gap: var(--label-gap); min-width: 0;",
  ".request-detail-price dt": "font-size: 16px; font-weight: 500; line-height: 1.5; color: var(--text); margin: 0; min-width: 0; word-break: keep-all; overflow-wrap: anywhere;",
  ".request-detail-price dd": "font-size: 16px; font-weight: 500; line-height: 1.5; margin: 0; margin-inline-start: auto; max-width: 100%; min-width: 0; text-align: end; word-break: keep-all; overflow-wrap: anywhere;",
  ".request-detail-total": "margin-top: 24px;",
  "#request-detail-total": "font-size: 18px; font-weight: 700; line-height: 1.5; color: var(--action);",
  ".request-detail-policy": "display: grid; gap: 4px; margin-top: 16px;",
  ".request-detail-policy p": "font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; line-height: 1.5; color: var(--muted); margin: 0; word-break: keep-all; overflow-wrap: anywhere;",
  ".request-detail-actions": "background-color: var(--surface); padding: 16px var(--page-inset) 24px;",
  "#cancel-request": "width: 100%; min-height: 48px; padding: 12px; border: 0; border-radius: 8px; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 600; line-height: 1.5; word-break: keep-all; overflow-wrap: anywhere;",
  "#review-view .booking-total dd": "color: var(--action);"
}
